scientific_integrity: Exact convex KKT rank exhaustion; finite rational checker is corroborative, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Three-dimensional unit-diagonal SPD quadratics with strictly positive correlations; fixed serial exact coordinate minimization only. The E-optimal-design publication-priority comparison is not exhaustive; an older general exact-design article was not accessible in full. Independent validation has not been performed.
title: An exact four-candidate rule for minimax sampling of three positively correlated coordinates
